info.name: FinMarket Enterprise | Phase II - Complete API Tests
info.description:
Run all folders sequentially against a disposable development database with mock delivery providers. Set baseUrl (includes /api/v1), adminEmail and adminPassword privately before running. Provision ADMIN using npm run admin:provision in backend. Unique fixtures are created each run. No real credentials are included. Covers all mounted HTTP method/path combinations. Successful retry of a FAILED delivery, genuine expired JWT, provider failure, worker concurrency, Docker persistence and outages require separate automated/manual fixtures; the collection tests invalid retry. Do not export populated credentials or tokens. Tests are statically reviewed, not live executed.

Before a full run, provision an Administrator and set adminEmail and adminPassword privately; verify Administrator login returns 200. The sample simulation sends an empty JSON object. Run-generated IDs and tokens are cleared at the start of each run.
V3 isolates generated variables and explicitly supplies the current token in request headers. Login identity is checked against the registered fixture.
